items.title: MCP 2026-07-28 specification ships: stateless core, Tasks, and MCP Apps now live

key_claims.claim: Stateless spec removes Mcp-Session-Id and initialize handshake
Deprecation grace period: minimum 12 months between Deprecated and Removed
MCP Apps: sandboxed iframe delivery via server-rendered HTML
GitHub MCP Server pre-emptive support: July 23, 2026

caveats: Primary SDK blog returned HTTP 503; spec confirmed through release candidate post, GitHub Changelog, and developer migration guides

items.title: EU AI Act Digital Omnibus enters into force July 27: high-risk deadline moves to December 2027

key_claims.claim: High-risk Annex III deadline: August 2, 2026 → December 2, 2027
Annex I embedded products: August 2, 2026 → August 2, 2028
Article 50 still applies August 2, 2026
Fines for Article 50 violations: up to €15M or 3% of global turnover

caveats: EU EUR-Lex direct URL not confirmed; compliance picture verified through Gibson Dunn, aiactblog.nl, ComplianceHub.Wiki

items.title: Molt: NVIDIA ships PyTorch-native agentic reinforcement learning framework at 1T-class scale

key_claims.claim: ~9,200 lines of RL code
Scales to 1T-class MoE on vLLM
Statistically comparable to Megatron-based stack on matched async protocol
Apache 2.0 license

caveats: Performance comparison vs Megatron is on a matched fully-asynchronous protocol — not independently verified

items.title: NVIDIA and OpenAI in talks for $250B data center financing backstop

key_claims.claim: Nvidia backstop: ~$250B for lease and construction debt
Accelerator purchase talks: up to $350B separately
Facility: 10 GW, southern Ohio, SB Energy (SoftBank subsidiary)
Project total: >$500B

caveats: Figures sourced from WSJ via Bloomberg/CNBC secondary — not from Nvidia or OpenAI official communications
Terms still moving; deal may not close

items.title: Sam Altman: "We are now, like, in the singularity"

key_claims.claim: Quote: "We are now, like, in the singularity"
Expert dissent: singularity claim disputed by Brian Jackson, Info-Tech Research Group

caveats: "Singularity" as used by Altman is a loosely-defined term, not a technical milestone
No independent expert consensus supports the capability claim — T2 for attribution only, T4 for the underlying claim
